snippet.title: ELEMENTAL MONSTER -ONLINE CARD GAME- Playstation 3 gameplay HD high definition
snippet.description: This is a ranked online match from the famous $.99 game with a platinum trophy that's on Playstation Network known as Elemental Monster Online Card Game.  It's actually quite addictive, and provides well over 20 hours worth of gameplay on the single player alone.  While it's possible to collect every card that's in the game through playing multiplayer, buying a few expansion booster boxes helps speed things along.
